book.name: Luqaas
book.title: Luqaasin Thaapoono Imbaa Wontea Yesus Kiristoossa Dhacchintan Goynam Giyayno Barjosa Upsino

content: Shivea Wannisin Giyoono Barjosa Upsino

Roome peen bitaa Thibaroos bitimaysaka tabhi dongsoa leveaka, Bhenthenaawi Bhilathoos Yiwda peenam wottsea ki dahade; Herodisaar Galila peenam wottsea ki dahade; iishima Pilbhoosaar Thurasbee Ithirakondoosbe peenam wottsea ki dahade; Lisaaniyosaar Abileene peenam wottsea ki dahade.
Hannabee Qayappabe gudullasa gembha ke dahade. Ogo wodanka Zakkarias naasa Wannis darante ki daaka, Barjosa upsino kikal ko nivade.
Ogonante Wannis Yordaanoos baynsa gasante dohon peen wulir “Yesa seesonin shidhoadettsi, seeson waadimanam garayse Barjodar maatayse shiidhee” hamaate Barjosa upsinam giyada ki yaayade.
Ogonoar yin konin dohoono Barjokala qansayse eenna giyea Isiasin giyenka:

content.text: yesa woylaminam ashkee; goynamaar kina gaz hayee.
Eeno wul Barjosa dhacchintanam koda shede’
hamayse ilatea easa upsino darante koda qansime”

content: hamayse ena birayse Isiassa mathaapinte thaapadhondettsi ko maatade.
Ogonante kikal shiidhanna nivon eenna Wannis yin ki giyade: “Yedi qarshi naanato, niven Barjosa wacimera gobayse yenin dhaqoadettsi yeam kiilaa hayne?

Ta keeda seeson waadimanam garayse Barjodar yenin maatonam dhehen payyan waadiman waadadhee. Yesa woylaminkaar ‘Wodi Abraam naasine’ hamayse erimeebhode. Yena ida giye: Barjo yi zaganna kina sennara Abraamna naasi hayayse dhaasana dama ki dame.
Ta haaqanaam taxate dhabayno tesimbho demente kesa wodadhidine; ogonante payyan aapin ushimina haaqana wulam taxate nuunte koda dhabadhe” kena ki hamade.
Eenoar “Ta har haya ko woam zaske?” hamayse Wannisam oysite ko dahade.
Kidiar “Apala lamaa yisa dahaa kalaam qolmaana ki ime; gala yisa dahaar ogodettsi ki haye” hamayse kena ki maasade.
Gibirin kacchaynaar kikal shiidhanna nivayse, “Woam Dhettsea, woam ta har haya ko zaske?” hamayse kiam ke oysade.
Kidiar “Yena yigginte giidhorra saskayse koymon tiyeebhode” hamayse kena ki maasade.

Poolisanaar nivayse, “Woamsin ta har haya ko zaske?” hamayse kiam ke oysade. Kidiar “Eensa koymonam kantaka buurate tiyeebhode; hayyeamaar buudamoka berseebhode; yesa waadimanna yena imbhayno bazano yena ko yeeke” hamayse kena ki maasade.
Ogo wodanka eenoar Wannissa dhalqinam bhocchaate wozaka kaalite, “Kaa ea Barjoyn qadhaa Kiristoos doo ki dew?” hamayse yisa woylaminka qaabite ko dahade.

Wannisaar ke wulna yin ki giyade: “Inta noqoka yeam ida shive; ko dahaannaar idara kantanka sagea niva ki nive. Inta kisa dunngurinsa dhaxinam hattear bulana damimane. Kidi Manpas Gazanbee nuubeka yeam kida shive.
Gazgonam qanayse puqulara aapinam kinin bulea anngamo kisa aaninte ko dahade. Aapinam payya ashkayse yisa kononte kida kee; puqulanamaar dikimon nuunte kida koqe” ki hamade.
Ogonante eenaam thoothi waana waana hama goytika kiilaate Barjosa dhacchintan upsinam kena giyte ki dahade.
Ko dahaannaar, Galila peenam wottsea Herodis iishima Pilbhoossa geshon Herodiyadaam kinin keemonnabee kinin waadadhon siyon waadiman wulbena Wannis kiam ki wacimade.
Ogona Herodis yinin waadadhon siyon waadiman wulra saskayse, pir Wannisam dhaxin ooninte ki dhaskade.
Yesussa Shiidhidino
Een wulin shiidhenka Yesusaar ki shiidhade. Barjoam kinin miskenka cecino ko bulimade,
Manpas Gazanoar waleedettsi maatayse kidar ko hanchade. “Inin nashea isa Naasa yane; hanka ida wozadhe” hamea upsi cecira ko qansimade.
Yesussa Muldhano
Yesus eenaam dhettsan kinin yedenka lendho kisa eedi kalaa kaysa apo tabhiaddhane. Eenna Yesus Yoseep naasi kida maate. Yesussa eykena kinane:
